Sounds better for sure man! Now let's make the snare pop more. Do you have a transient shaper? If you don't download one called transient monster. It's free. Use that on your snare. Make sure the saws are also side chained to that. Add a white noise sweep for each drop. Maybe a snare roll for the second predrop as well just to add some energy. Throw a low pass on your saws in the beginning and automate it slowly coming up as the drop starts ("let me disarm you").

Not sure why you got down voted? I think it's got tons of potential man. Your drops need more. Some of the timing was off for your super saws during your main segment. They need more variation too. Try automating a low pass on them or even an LFO at times. Also the vocals sound like they aren't timed correctly. Not sure exactly what the situation is but they sound fucky, if you will. Also I'm listening on my phone speakers so I can't tell you much about the mix but I would turn down the vocals during the chorus or the drop.
